text:
Record of a focused evening
The handover meeting began on time, with the welfare lead in the chair

Attendees were Rina Clark, Mateo Fischer, and the welcome team.

The group reviewed how the welcome team should keep passengers calm and informed before boarding, with attention to species, temperament, and comfort. It was agreed that clear handoffs help prevent stress for both families and pets, and that small checks done early usually save trouble later. Ranger was mentioned as a good reminder to keep travel plans simple, gentle, and predictable.

The discussion then moved to care notes and boarding flow. <<FACT F053>> The team shared that steady communication between desk staff and boarding staff helps reassure travelers, and that a friendly update can make a real difference when plans change. Everyone supported the goal of dependable companion travel at Aurelia Skyways, with an emphasis on patience, practical guidance, and calm service.

The meeting ended with agreement on continued close coordination and a smooth end to the evening.
